title: Amazon's robotaxi Zoox launches first paid service in U.S.
excerpt: The carriage-style Zoox vehicles differ from Waymo's autonomous cars.
content_html:
There’s a new robotaxi in town — Amazon's Zoox.

Paid rides on Zoox became available for the first time ever, with service launching in Las Vegas on Monday (Aug. 10). The Sin City service follows Zoox's recent availability as a free option for select San Francisco riders. 

While Alphabet's autonomous Waymo cars are also available in Vegas, Zoox has some distinct differences, most notably its carriage-style seating made possible by the absence of a steering wheel and gas pedal. Zoox vehicles also lack a formal front or rear, allowing them to drive in either direction seamlessly. Riders adjust temperature and music choices on screens in the cabin.

On July 30, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration announced that Zoox could temporarily offer paid service. 

Mashable Light Speed

"This temporary exemption will allow the commercial deployment of up to 2,500 vehicles annually for two years, subject to an enhanced, adaptable oversight structure that can evolve as Zoox’s technology advances," according to the agency.

Zoox prices will be competitive with other rideshare services, according to the Los Angeles Times, with possible surcharges for trips to airports or special events. 

The Zoox app shows rides currently available in a wide swath of the Las Vegas Valley, with vehicles operating from 11 a.m. to 1 a.m. On-demand service in Austin, Miami, and San Francisco will be up next. 

Waymo recently announced its van-style Ojai service is available for free to select riders in Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Phoenix. While the Ojai has a steering wheel and pedals, it also features accessibility options such as elevator-style doors, low step entry and exit, and three large LED screens for customizing music and temperature.

content_html_zh:
镇上有一种新的机器人出租车——亚马逊的 Zoox。

Zoox 于周一（8 月 10 日）在拉斯维加斯推出了付费乘车服务。 罪恶之城服务紧随 Zoox 最近推出，作为特定旧金山乘客的免费选项。

虽然 Alphabet 的自动驾驶 Waymo 汽车也可以在维加斯使用，但 Zoox 有一些明显的区别，最引人注目的是它的马车式座椅，因为没有方向盘和油门踏板。 Zoox 车辆也没有正式的前部或后部，使它们能够无缝地向任一方向行驶。 乘客可以在机舱内的屏幕上调节温度和音乐选择。

7月30日，美国国家公路交通安全管理局宣布Zoox可以暂时提供付费服务。

可混搭光速

该机构表示：“这项临时豁免将允许在两年内每年最多 2,500 辆汽车进行商业部署，但要遵守可随着 Zoox 技术进步而发展的增强型、适应性强的监督结构。”

据《洛杉矶时报》报道，Zoox 的价格将比其他拼车服务更具竞争力，并且可能会对前往机场或特殊活动收取附加费。

Zoox 应用程序显示了拉斯维加斯山谷大片地区目前提供的游乐设施，车辆从上午 11 点开始运营。 至凌晨 1 点 接下来将在奥斯汀、迈阿密和旧金山提供按需服务。

Waymo 最近宣布其厢式货车式 Ojai 服务免费向洛杉矶、旧金山和凤凰城的部分乘客提供。 虽然 Ojai 有方向盘和踏板，但它还具有无障碍选项，例如电梯式门、低台阶入口和出口以及三个用于定制音乐和温度的大型 LED 屏幕。
